# Invoicing

<!-- generated by .kb/generate.mjs — do not edit by hand -->

**Layer:** package + database + api  
**Status:** in progress

## Purpose

The clinic billing a PATIENT: one engine, many billable sources, the clinic's own registration, immutable once issued. ⚠️ NOT `subscription_invoices`, which is rcln billing the clinic and is complete — see §0.1 of the invoice-engine log for why the two cannot share a table.

## Features

- `invoices` / `invoice_items` / `invoice_taxes` / `invoice_documents` — org AND branch scoped, composite-FK'd throughout
- `issueInvoiceNumber()` — `INV-{PERIOD_YEAR}-{SOURCE}-{BRANCH_CODE}-{000001}` on top of the existing gapless `issueNumber()` counter
- The reset cadence is resolved from the branch's country — financial year for IN, calendar year elsewhere — and the period is the BRANCH-LOCAL date, resolved in Postgres
- Every tax field on an invoice is a snapshot: registration number, legal name, place of supply, line names, rates. Nothing is ever re-read
- One TYPED, enforced reference column per integrated source — `appointment_id` today, `lab_order_id` and `pharmacy_sale_id` with their modules — never a generic polymorphic id. `source_type` still ships as the full seven-value enum so the shape does not change when they land
- `priceInvoice()` in `@rcln/invoicing` — the ONLY code allowed to decide what goes in a money column. Pure: integer minor units, no Prisma, no clock, `quoteTax` passed in as a function
- The calculation order is fixed once and implemented once: gross → line discount → apportioned invoice discount → per-line tax → cash rounding, each step rounded at the currency's own scale before the next reads it
- `apportion()` — largest-remainder split of the invoice-level discount pro-rata by taxable amount, ties broken on the lower index so a reprint matches the original exactly
- Quantity is an integer count of THOUSANDTHS, matching `Decimal(14,3)` — a float unit price is how a line comes out a paisa short of the sum of its parts
- Cash rounding is applied to the TOTAL and never to a line, and lands in its own column so `grand_total` never needs explaining
- `priceDraftInvoice()` — the seam: one tax-context read per invoice, then pure arithmetic. Persists nothing; finalisation is phase 5
- `createDraftInvoice()` / `repriceDraftInvoice()` — a draft is PRICED from the moment it exists; there is no state in which an invoice's totals are not the totals of its lines
- `finalizeInvoice()` — price, refuse an unrated line, refuse a branch its registration does not cover, then take the number: DRAFT → FINALIZING → ISSUED in one transaction
- `cancelDraftInvoice()` / `voidInvoice()` — cancel is for a draft nobody ever saw, void is for a document that keeps its number for ever
- Three database triggers, not one service: `invoices_lifecycle_guard` (the transition table + a frozen-column ALLOW-LIST), `invoices_no_delete_after_issue`, `invoice_children_follow_parent`
- The frozen set is an allow-list, so a column added to `invoices` tomorrow is immutable after issue by default and somebody has to argue for it
- `toDecimal()` / `toMoney()` — the ONE `numeric(14,2)` ↔ minor-units boundary for patient invoices, via the string form and never `.toNumber()`
- The finalisation check `branches.region_code` was always missing: a clinic registered in one state cannot issue from a branch in another, because `registrationFor()` would silently fall back to the wrong GSTIN
- `loadInvoiceDocumentData()` — an invoice row assembled into the plain-JSON snapshot the document renders from. The ONE place an invoice becomes a document, so the preview and the PDF cannot be assembled differently
- The snapshot beats the live row: a clinic that renames itself does not silently restate an invoice somebody is holding
- What the document CALLS ITSELF is derived, not a constant — a Bill of Supply for an exempt Indian supply, a plain Invoice for an unregistered clinic, a Tax Invoice in AU/NZ/SG/AE and not in the UK or Ireland
- `issueInvoice()` — finalise in a transaction, COMMIT, then enqueue the render. Enqueueing inside the transaction races the worker against the commit; a failed enqueue is logged and never fails the request, because by then the invoice IS a document

## Business rules

- [A number is taken at finalisation, never at creation, so an abandoned draft burns no serial — enforced by the `invoices_number_matches_status` CHECK, not by a service remembering to](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#a number is taken at finalisation, never at creation, so an abandoned draft burns no serial — enforced by the `invoices_number_matches_status` check, not by a service remembering to)
- [The series is per branch and the branch code is IN the number: two branches sharing one GSTIN must never issue the same serial](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#the series is per branch and the branch code is in the number: two branches sharing one gstin must never issue the same serial)
- [An invoice-level discount is apportioned onto the lines BEFORE tax, largest-remainder — tax on a pre-discount amount is over-collected tax remitted on money nobody received](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#an invoice-level discount is apportioned onto the lines before tax, largest-remainder — tax on a pre-discount amount is over-collected tax remitted on money nobody received)
- [Tax is rounded per line, not per invoice, which is what makes each printed line internally consistent](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#tax is rounded per line, not per invoice, which is what makes each printed line internally consistent)
- [The customer block is a snapshot, not a join: a patient who changes their surname does not change an invoice already issued](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#the customer block is a snapshot, not a join: a patient who changes their surname does not change an invoice already issued)
- [An issued invoice is VOIDed, never deleted — the number stays so the series stays contiguous](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#an issued invoice is voided, never deleted — the number stays so the series stays contiguous)
- [An invoice's link to what it bills is enforced by the database, composite-keyed to (organization_id, id), so it can never cite another clinic's row; `invoices_source_reference_matches_type` keeps the source type and the reference column agreeing](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#an invoice's link to what it bills is enforced by the database, composite-keyed to (organization_id, id), so it can never cite another clinic's row; `invoices_source_reference_matches_type` keeps the source type and the reference column agreeing)
- [A discount larger than what it reduces is REFUSED, never clamped: a negative charge is a credit note and goes through a different door](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#a discount larger than what it reduces is refused, never clamped: a negative charge is a credit note and goes through a different door)
- [The invoice-level discount is weighted by what is LEFT of a line after its own discount, not by its gross — weighting by gross pushes an already-free line negative](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#the invoice-level discount is weighted by what is left of a line after its own discount, not by its gross — weighting by gross pushes an already-free line negative)
- [One UNRATED or PROVIDER_REQUIRED line makes the whole document unissuable, decided by `isIssuable()` so the engine and finalisation cannot drift](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#one unrated or provider_required line makes the whole document unissuable, decided by `isissuable()` so the engine and finalisation cannot drift)
- [The invoice tax total is summed from the PRINTED lines, never taken from a quote's own total — the lines are what a patient can add up on the page](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#the invoice tax total is summed from the printed lines, never taken from a quote's own total — the lines are what a patient can add up on the page)
- [An ISSUED invoice's document may not change — status, `amount_paid` and the cancel/void fields are the only columns that still move, enforced by trigger and not by the service](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#an issued invoice's document may not change — status, `amount_paid` and the cancel/void fields are the only columns that still move, enforced by trigger and not by the service)
- [An issued invoice's LINES are frozen with it: a frozen `grand_total` over editable lines is an invoice stating a total that is not the sum of what it prints](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#an issued invoice's lines are frozen with it: a frozen `grand_total` over editable lines is an invoice stating a total that is not the sum of what it prints)
- [CANCELLED is reachable from DRAFT only and VOID from an issued state only — the difference is whether anybody ever saw the document](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#cancelled is reachable from draft only and void from an issued state only — the difference is whether anybody ever saw the document)
- [A draft is re-priced at finalisation from its stored INPUTS, never trusted, so a rate corrected since the draft was opened reaches the document](../BusinessRules/Invoicing.md#a draft is re-priced at finalisation from its stored inputs, never trusted, so a rate corrected since the draft was opened reaches the document)

## Known limitations

- Only APPOINTMENT has a reference column, because it is the only source whose table exists. PROCEDURE and SERVICE carry no reference at all until a service catalogue exists, and LAB / PHARMACY / INVENTORY gain theirs in the migration that creates their own table
- No routes, no contracts, no screen and no permission wiring — phases 5 to 9
- Lab, pharmacy and inventory sources have no tables to point at; only APPOINTMENT, PROCEDURE, SERVICE and OTHER can be billed
- Tax behaviour is EXCLUSIVE only — there is no inclusive-pricing path, and `netOf()` in `@rcln/tax` has no caller. It matters for consumer-facing EU/UK prices
- No credit note: no table, no series, no `CREDIT_NOTE` source type. A void records a reason and nothing else — and with no patient-payments table `amount_paid` is always zero, so no void can yet involve money
- PARTIALLY_PAID and PAID are reachable transitions with nothing to drive them; there is no patient payments/allocations pair
- Cash rounding and the invoice currency are parameters, not settings — `resolveSettings()` has no billing keys and Phase 7's settings screen is where they belong
- No routes, no contracts, no screen and no permission wiring — phases 6 to 9. `billing.invoice.*` still gates nothing
- The PDF is asynchronous: an invoice is ISSUED before its document exists. The screen renders from data so nothing waits to SEE the invoice — only Download waits
